reason: $15 a visit is a lot on our budget when the library, parks and free story times are right there. I'd take the free first visit, but I wouldn't pay after that.
objection: Fifteen dollars every time I want to get out of the house adds up fast, and with a baby and a toddler it's more once I count a sibling and snacks. It feels pricey for Salisbury.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8 to $10, or a free or cheap weekday morning session for families on a tight budget.
